feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Nino has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A red moon rising between the trees, breathing — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 30s, with a buzz cut mutters "We've been walking past those." the person in their 30s says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what ar

🔥 The fire settles. the woman in her 30s, with a buzz cut has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dylan asks "And you're still standing." Omar says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Josefina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Evelyn says quietly "Say that again — slower." Adaeze breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
💛 The Home key is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
💛 The Boot stone is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
📖 The memory leaves something behind: This one channels harder than the rest. Love with nowhere to go.
💛 The Wedding Ring is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Lucky Coin is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)

🔥 The fire settles. Omar has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Pedro asks "And you're still standing." Nino mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.

🔥 The fire settles. Josefina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dylan asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Omar says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
